Invoke 'chest_xray_expert' to confirm the presence of the general pathology if not already established.
2. Identify the forced-choice options representing different anatomical locations (e.g., 'left lower lobe' vs. 'left upper lobe').
3. Invoke 'xray_phrase_grounding' for each option text individually to generate bounding boxes.
4. Analyze the spatial coordinates of the returned bounding boxes (e.g., vertical position y-coordinates, anterior/posterior location).
5. Map the coordinates to known anatomical landmarks (e.g., lower lobes are typically posterior/basal; upper lobes are anterior/superior).
6. Select the option whose grounded region matches the expected anatomical location for that lobe.
7.
